join_rules.description: All 35 data tables share hex_id (H3 level-8). Direct equi-join on hex_id.
Filter any data table by County through the crosswalk table. Join data table to crosswalk on hex_id, then filter on County.
Filter any data table by State through the crosswalk table. Join data table to crosswalk on hex_id, then filter on State.
Filter any data table by Zipcode through the crosswalk table. Join data table to crosswalk on hex_id, then filter on Zipcode.
Aggregate any data table from H3 level-8 to level-7. Join to crosswalk on hex_id, then GROUP BY hex_id_l7.
Aggregate any data table from H3 level-8 to level-6. Join to crosswalk on hex_id, then GROUP BY hex_id_l6.
Spatial join via geometry column. Tables with geometry: HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N.
